title: wiki-revert-audit: code, aggregates and logs for "Which reverts count? Reverter populations, attribution rules and observation windows behind a Wikipedia indicator of information quality work"
description: Analysis pipeline, cell-level aggregates, figure data, the coding table of a survey of reporting practice, registered text, deviation log and AI-assistance log for a measurement audit of Wikipedia revert-based indicators. The first edits of 3.2 million newcomers in seven language editions are held fixed while the reverter population (bots, one-click tools, other editors, unregistered editors, the authors themselves), the attribution rule (the unbounded identity-revert flag of the history dumps, a 15-revision radius rule, the mw-reverted change tag) and the observation window are varied. Data: Wikimedia mediawiki_history dumps, version 2026-09. Registration: 10.5281/zenodo.23720117. Most analyses are exploratory; the registered tests concern a secondary question.

creators.name: Jeong, Hongwon
creators.affiliation: Center for Creative Convergence Education, Hanyang University ERICA

notes: Editor-level derived data are not included because they could be re-identified from public edit histories; the code regenerates them from the dumps. Generative AI (Claude, Anthropic; for one check ChatGPT, OpenAI) assisted with drafting code and documents and with the survey of reporting practice; see 04_logs/AI_ASSISTANCE_LOG.md.
